description: Archipelago — Colore: Mercury & silver Collezione: Serēnus Codice: 5961 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 139.5 cm Rapporto: 46.5 cm × 28.5 cm Toni: Light grey, Light green ARCHIPELAGO maps the silhouettes of islands significant to the history of Fortuny onto fabric , a composition that acknowledges both individuality and interconnectedness through form rather than words. Scattered and irregular, the small -scale repeat creates movement through distribution rather than repetition alone, lending the fabric an expansive, landscape-like quality. The SEREÑUS version is printed on cotton with a refined hand suited to upholstery, drapery, and wall applications across residential and light contract projects. Its tonal palette — developed to evoke the seasonal skies of Venice — makes it a fabric that changes character with light and hour. Part of the SEREÑUS collection , Fortuny's last of the first 100 years of production on the Giudecca, established 1921.
